categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Labeled RPC/REST/ZMQ and modifies HTTP server internals in src/httpserver.cpp and src/httpserver.h alongside interface_http.py.
categories.rationale: Fixes an intermittently failing functional regression test for HTTP receive-throttling by introducing debug logging on bytes buffered and received per client. As noted in issue #36216 and the description, client-side socket assertions failed across OS stacks (like macOS window autosizing), so testing via server-side log assertions stabilizes CI without altering functional RPC behavior.
